summary: Phase 2 Multi-Énergie — Capability Map: FULL backend + frontend validation. 48/48 pytest pass (30 access_link non-regression + 18 new test_capabilities). Backend: GET /api/vehicles/capabilities returns success=true, tenant='default', 37 records for Techlift with exact counts (gps=37, odometer=33, engine_hours=27, fuel_level=3, vin_obd=4); every value carries {value,unit,unit_verified,source,update_time,status ∈ AVAILABLE|STALE|UNAVAILABLE}. FlexMobil (via impersonation POST /admin/impersonation/start {tenant:'flex'} + X-Act-As-Tenant:flex): 52 records with all 4 landmark vehicles exactly conformant — Zoe(3467705) motorisation.normalized='unknown', source='none', fuel_level.available=false, ALL 7 ev_* keys available=false status=UNAVAILABLE with note 'Aucun paramètre EV vérifié'; Prius(3467697) dtc.codes=['P0A80'] status=STALE update_time='2026-06-05 16:36:07', vin.obd==vin.garage conflict=false; Porto(3467691) fuel_level.available=true value=93.0 unit='%' unit_verified=true status=AVAILABLE; Tigizirt(3467715) unverified_sensors contains both 'obd_absolute_load_value' (Valeur absolue de charge) and 'avl_io_49' (Autonomie restante), ev_range.available=false. Individual GET /api/vehicles/{tid}/capabilities OK; unknown tracker → 404. Isolation: admin@test-beta.local (fake Navixy hash) → {success:false, error:'Échec récupération trackers'}, no records; X-Act-As-Tenant:flex header IGNORED for non-super-admin (same clean error, no leak). Fleet /stats has data_status:{mileage/odometer/engine_hours:'ok'}, every vehicle has 'fuel_type' field, 4 vehicles have total_odometer=null (never fabricated 0); /fleet/efficiency also has data_status. Fuel consumption test: PUT /api/config/fuel {default_consumption_rate:7} → 35/37 Techlift vehicles get fuel_used_liters computed (2 with mileage=0 → null), config reset via DELETE. Cache: 2nd call ~0.2s (from mem/Mongo TTL 6h), ?refresh=true ~4.6s. PDF export starts with %PDF-1.4, CSV export contains French headers. Impersonation ended cleanly. FRONTEND (Playwright via super-admin → Clients → FlexMobil → Aperçu client): Vehicules tab loads with 52 rows, 36 motor-badges (16 unknown-fuel vehicles including Zoe show NO badge as required), 52 fuel-level cells (Porto=93%, others '—'), NO partial-data-banner. Vehicle sheet: capabilities-panel visible for Zoe with 'Télématique EV (SoC, kWh, recharge) — Non détectée', unverified-sensors block present. Prius sheet dtc-codes shows 'Codes défaut OBD : P0A80 — MAJ 2026-06-05 16:36:07 (donnée ancienne)'. Motorisation override select present in Gestion interne edit mode with exact options ['— Selon garage —','Diesel','Essence','Hybride','Hybride rechargeable','Électrique'] — override NOT saved (kept blank per instructions). No console errors during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Techlift tracker 3573147 ('just_registered' Volkswagen T6) returns total_odometer=0.0 from Navixy — this is a real value, not fabricated, but for consistency with the 'never zero' policy the analytics layer could treat mileage==0 && last_update==null && connection_status=='just_registered' as null. Currently 4 vehicles are null and 1 shows 0.0. Non-blocking.
VehiclesTab.jsx (754 lines) is close to the 700-line file-size guideline — consider extracting MotorBadge/FuelLevel/CapabilitiesPanel into a separate module for maintainability.
